svg.text: Noesis + Menon Coordinate, Calibration, and Projection Map
Live runtime paths, persisted calibration stores, offline artifacts, and final visualization consumers.

Mental model: Noesis owns BACKEND_WORLD_M; Menon owns MENON SCENE / OBJ; align.matrix + s_obj_to_m bridge them; K/E bridge pixels to camera/world; frontend reprojection adds the environment mesh as an active geometry source.
